decision_rule.critical_harm: Any observed wrong-player/original/date/game, unsupported availability/starter, qualifier/negation loss or invented claim in an eligible final output disqualifies a superiority claim for that arm in this experiment.
decision_rule.coverage: Among arms with no observed critical harm, compare paired usable source updates and missed actionable claims on independently adjudicated holdout families. Require family-bootstrap 95% interval for usable-update difference above zero, no measured recall loss, at least 30 adjudicated holdout families and no unresolved material label dispute. Otherwise inconclusive or report a tradeoff.
decision_rule.cost: Use actual complete model-token and fee charges per correctly supported eligible source update; report zero denominators as undefined. Cost is secondary to harm and coverage.
decision_rule.limitations: These are descriptive small-experiment criteria, not population-safety, calibration, external hockey truth or future-performance certification. Both endpoints use Luna; agreement is correlated assistance.

bootstrap.weight: equal family, paired posts within family

thresholds.status: uncalibrated pilot default; changes require new frozen config before holdout
